description: Data karyawan fiktif: 18 orang, 7 sudah resign. Dipakai di Studi Kasus 3.2: Kenapa Karyawan Resign.

samples.label: yang sudah resign
samples.sql: SELECT nama, divisi, tgl_masuk, tgl_keluar FROM karyawan WHERE status = 'resign';

samples.label: turnover per divisi
samples.sql: SELECT divisi, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'resign' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resign FROM karyawan GROUP BY divisi;

samples.label: masa kerja yang resign
samples.sql: SELECT nama, ROUND((julianday(tgl_keluar) - julianday(tgl_masuk)) / 30, 1) AS bulan_kerja FROM karyawan WHERE status = 'resign' ORDER BY bulan_kerja;
